purpose: Desired public outcomes and measured baseline evidence. Root-cause suggestions are separate and are not implementation requirements.

baseline.workingTree: Outcome tests and minimal QA support only; production code unchanged.
baseline.expectedGate: Intentionally failing baseline regression, never a passing done gate.
baseline.currency: Required goal check refreshed this worker onto current main. The three intervening commits touch Goal allowance tooling and an archived brief only; no API owner changed.

fixture.composition: Real Account HTTP and composeMain with lifecycle, relay, Content, Access, Fuseki and PostgreSQL; no owner mocks.
fixture.creation: Public commands for Works, chapter Content, eligibility, watched replies, Realms/Zones and independent Account rating observations. grantPersonaFixtureAuthority only for narrow preparation authority.
fixture.reuse: One stopped consistent owner backup under .temp/audit-bounded-reads/owners plus private mode-0600 corpus.json; each run restores isolated fresh owners, never reads shared development storage.
fixture.privacy: Retained credentials never enter this document or Git.
fixture.instrumentation: Transparent HTTP proxy records actual graph requests, bytes, timing and trace IDs; optional 20 ms latency exposes in-flight cancellation without replacing an owner. Real OTLP runtime propagates traces. SQL/engine bounds are unknown until separately instrumented, never inferred as zero.

populations.notifications: 50 member-authored replies plus a moderator-authored non-self notice

distinctions.null: Absent optional subject/display/rating/diagnostic value; never fabricate a preview or zero count.
distinctions.unknown: Membership count or unmeasured SQL/engine work stays unknown; do not turn it into exact zero.
distinctions.incomplete: A partial page carries an advancing continuation and at-least count, even when items is empty.
distinctions.unavailable: An unready/unavailable owner is an explicit 503; never return an exact empty page or null rating to hide it.
distinctions.noData: An exact zero-rating population has mean null and no-data precision; it differs from an unavailable aggregate.

resourceList.explanation: Existing resource-list 32 plus existing Realm-directory supplement 163 for mixed all scope.
resourceList.sqlMeasurement: unknown; graph wire trace is measured

notificationRead.scope: One complete stream request or unread-count request, including all subject hydration and fences.
notificationRead.sqlEngineBudget: Required shared allocation; concrete instrumentation/limits remain unproved here.

chapterSearch.graphCalls: Existing Main Work request allocation; unrelated Content population may not be charged to each reader.
chapterSearch.notes: No timeout or MAX_PUBLIC_UNITS increase is a repair.

suggestions.notes: Existing bounded candidate window stays; total official population may grow.

globalAggregate.notes: One whole-request allocation; no raising 100-slot verifier ceiling to satisfy the population test.

refreshDesired.contract: Terminal permanent evidence is retained and isolated until basis/source changes; ordinary transient faults retain bounded retry. No fixed perpetual retry hides permanent invalidity.

baselineExceptions.reason: Baseline explicitly projects identities and source evidence, never title/media/metadata. The audit invalid-media foreground-hydration producer cannot be used to assert persistent refresh failure here.
baselineExceptions.remainingEvidence: refresh.ts still maps arbitrary failures to retry with bounded exponential delay but no terminal classification. This code observation alone does not prove the public failure.
baselineExceptions.managerAction: Do not dispatch an API repair based on the passing diagnostic control. Require an admitted public persistent-fault producer or a separately owned owner/fault proof.

rootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: Per-notification subject hydration starts nested Work read sessions without one request-wide allocation or caller signal.
rootCauseHypotheses.status: Await baseline trace; desired behavior does not prescribe batching/cache mechanism.

rootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: Default all scans/hydrates source kinds before returning a bounded mixed page and can exhaust its request allocation.
Serialized continuation state can exceed its own admitted cursor schema, or cannot advance within the mixed-source allocation.
rootCauseHypotheses.status: A first-page 422 does not prove cursor round-trip; record actual assertion location.

rootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: Request-time qualifyContent caches only by joint source/graph position and performs full eligibility inventory audits on cold/advanced reads.
rootCauseHypotheses.status: Await trace; no requirement to weaken eligibility or privacy.

rootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: An internal 8-candidate Zone page rejects a next cursor instead of bounded selection/traversal.
An internal 100-slot verifier ceiling has become a public total population cap.
